Overlooking vineyards, this quaint guesthouse, parts of which date from the 11th century, is set 8 km from both the Piazza della Cisterna and the Collegiate Church of San Gimignano.

About this hotel

Overlooking vineyards, this quaint guesthouse, parts of which date from the 11th century, is set 8 km from both the Piazza della Cisterna and the Collegiate Church of San Gimignano.

Check-in time: 14:00
Check-out time: 11:00

Tuscany Vineyard Hotel | Torciano
Hotel Torciano is a Tuscany vineyard Hotel located in the midst of the vineyards of Chianti region, in San Gimignano. Here you can live a unique experience.
